messages:
sarah_pm: Heads up — Snowflare reached out with a proposed launch window for the Unity Catalog connector. They want a coordinated announcement + marketplace listing the week of May 4. Can we align on tech gating and release readiness?

josh_partnerships: copying notes from last call: Snowflare expects a "go-live" API contract by Apr 20, docs and install script by Apr 27, and marketplace assets by May 1. They also want a joint customer webinar ~May 7.

maria_eng: Tech gating: we need final integration tests for Unity Catalog ACL propagation and a fallback path to our vector-store routing when external functions latency > 500ms. ETA: integration tests + perf run by Apr 18 if we lock infra today.

kevin_ops: FYI infra constraints — the Dedicated pool we planned for the pilot has a maintenance window Apr 22-23. If we need canary traffic during Apr 24-30 we should provision burst capacity.

sarah_pm: good catch. can we avoid the maintenance window for the webinar? josh, can Snowflare shift any dates?

josh_partnerships: pinged their PM — they said flexibility +/- 1 week on the webinar. Announcement date is more rigid for their PR team (they prefer May 5).

maria_eng: proposed prelaunch checklist (short):
```
- integration tests: unity-acl propagation ✅
- perf: 95p latency < 300ms on canonical traces 
- fallback routing: vector DB path verified
- canary config: 5% traffic, auto rollback on error rate > 1%
- quantization/compat check for smallest supported GPU (A10)
```
I can take ownership of the perf test infra.

oliver_docs: I'll draft the marketplace listing copy and quickstart. Need a short install snippet and one-run example (Snowflake -> Redwood -> Vector DB). Please drop the command you want surfaced.

maria_eng: example CLI for quickstart: `redwood connector create --provider snowflare --catalog unity_catalog --auth-method keypair`

oliver_docs: perfect, will use that. Also will add a section about required Unity Catalog privileges (USAGE on catalog + SELECT on tables used for embeddings).

kevin_ops: marketplace note: to get featured placement the partner marketplace team requires test listing in staging by Apr 28 and a security self-attestation doc. I can run the staging push once docs are ready.

sarah_pm: action items:
- maria: finish perf + canary config by Apr 18
- oliver: draft listing & quickstart by Apr 25
- kevin: staging push + attestation the week of Apr 28
- josh: confirm Snowflare PR/announcement cadence + webinar date by Apr 10

please add anything I missed. :thumbsup:

josh_partnerships: added a note — need to confirm whether Snowflare will allow our marketplace image in their partner center (legal + co-branding). I'll follow up with legal.

marketplace_bot: Listing draft created in staging: `listing-2112233445-unity-bridge` — status: draft. Reviewer tags: oliver_docs, kevin_ops.

maria_eng: one more technical risk callout — Unity Catalog schema evolution for nested types can change our embedding extractor. I'll add a compatibility test to the suite and flag schema-mismatch errors in the canary.

sarah_pm: awesome. if everyone agrees, I'll lock the May 5 announcement as tentative and escalate if dates shift. Thanks team — let's use this thread for any gating updates.

josh_partnerships: ok, looping in legal in a separate DM. cc: @marketing for webinar coordination later.

kevin_ops: will book a staging push slot Apr 29 9:00 PT.

oliver_docs: will post a draft doc link here when ready.

marketplace_bot: Reminder scheduled: "staging push slot" on 2112490000 (calendar entry created).
